text:
LB::mode
Description
Sets the load balancing mode, overriding the mode set in the pool
definition
Syntax
LB
::
mode
[
default
|
rr
|
roundrobin
|
leastconns
|
fastest
|
predictive
|
observed
|
ratio
|
dynratio
|
nodeleastconns
|
noderatio
]
LB::mode <lb_mode>
Examples
when
LB_SELECTED
{
if
{
$myretry
>=
1
}
{
LB
::
mode
rr
LB
::
reselect
pool
$mypool
}
}
